findings.title: Scream probability and cooldown are update-rate dependent
findings.reproduction_evidence: The 3% roll runs every eligible OnPlayerUpdate with no throttle. Wolfram verification gives at-least-one-success probability 0.598992931457 in 30 ticks and 0.839193330978 in 60 ticks; over five seconds it is 0.989630444511 at 30 Hz and 0.999892472319 at 60 Hz. A 120-tick cooldown is 4 seconds at 30 Hz and 2 seconds at 60 Hz.
findings.missing_proof: Actual PZ update frequency distribution under different performance conditions.
findings.recommended_correction: Express eligibility and cooldown in game time or a fixed interval event, then calibrate a per-interval probability independent of frame/update rate.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Simulate equal wall-clock windows at 30 and 60 updates per second with deterministic time injection and assert identical roll opportunities and cooldown duration.
